card.name: Digits and small joiners in oncology label text
card.fires_on: Mid-number digits, spaces before numbers, and small joining words or commas inside oncology label sentences about adverse reactions, lab grades and assay values.

modes.label: Inside numbers
modes.description: The digit or space within a count, version, or exponent, such as patient counts or lab ranges.

modes.label: Joiners after drug or condition names
modes.description: A comma, 'with', 'can' or 'which' right after a drug or immune-related condition name.
modes.example: immune-mediated colitis,<< which>> may present with diarrhea

modes.label: Inside technical terms
modes.description: A space or letter inside a version number, IC value, or enzyme name.

card.plain: It fires on small bits of text, such as digits, spaces and commas, in the numbers and sentences of cancer drug labels.
